slot.brief: Two events with given individual probabilities and independence/intersection; compute P(A|B) or check whether A and B are independent using the definition.

stem: If $P(A)=\dfrac{3}{8}$, $P(B)=\dfrac{2}{3}$ and $P(A\cap B^c)=\dfrac{1}{8}$, find $P(A\mid B)$ and determine whether $A$ and $B$ are independent.

verdicts.working: P(A∩B)=P(A)−P(A∩Bᶜ)=3/8−1/8=1/4. Thus P(A|B)=(1/4)/(2/3)=3/8. Since P(A)P(B)=(3/8)(2/3)=1/4=P(A∩B), they are independent.

working:
$P(A\cap B)=P(A)-P(A\cap B^c)=\dfrac38-\dfrac18=\dfrac14$; $P(A\mid B)=\dfrac{1/4}{2/3}=\dfrac38$; $P(A)P(B)=\dfrac38\cdot\dfrac23=\dfrac14=P(A\cap B)$.

Independent check: P(A∩B)=P(A)−P(A∩Bᶜ)=3/8−1/8=1/4. Thus P(A|B)=(1/4)/(2/3)=3/8. Since P(A)P(B)=(3/8)(2/3)=1/4=P(A∩B), they are independent.
solution:
$P(A\cap B)=P(A)-P(A\cap B^c)=\dfrac38-\dfrac18=\dfrac14.$
$$P(A\mid B)=\dfrac{P(A\cap B)}{P(B)}=\dfrac{1/4}{2/3}=\dfrac38.$$
Since $P(A)P(B)=\dfrac38\cdot\dfrac23=\dfrac14=P(A\cap B)$, $A$ and $B$ are independent.
